id.description: Unique identifier generated via UUIDv5 based on canonical annotation content

parents.description: List of parent annotation IDs from which this annotation was derived

bopp_version.description: The Semantic Version of the BOPP schema (e.g., 1.0)

extent.description: The parallel array of time/space boundaries (e.g., time_interval, point)

payload.description: The parallel array of values (e.g., beat, chord)

confidence.description: Optional parallel array of likelihoods or votes

sandbox.description: Unstructured storage area for arbitrary user-defined data
